entities.name: Methyl arylacetate substrate
observations: Contains a methyl ester, aryl cyclopropylmethoxy group, and N-Boc-N-methylsulfonamide substituent.

entities.name: LiOH ester saponification
observations: LiOH hydrolyzes the methyl ester to the corresponding carboxylic acid; the immediate basic intermediate may be the lithium carboxylate.
The matched record reports the acid product in 95% yield using THF.
No evidence indicates aryl-ether cleavage or Boc deprotection.

entities.name: Arylacetic acid product
observations: Transformation replaces methyl ester COC(=O)– with carboxylic acid –C(=O)OH while retaining the other substituents.
